title: Manga 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Concludes Serialization
description: The editor of Oreco Tachibana's Hotaru no Yomeiri (Firefly Wedding) manga announced on Monday that it will end with the 79th chapter on February 2. MangaONE, the platform where the manga runs, further announced a two part spin-off story, Koi to Doku (Love and Poison), with the first part set for a February 2 release, followed by the second part on March 2.
